description.value: Friendship Inn Motel & RV Park is a combination motel and RV park located along the Island Highway in Campbell River, BC. The property offers both motel rooms and RV accommodation, and sits near beaches and hiking trails in the Campbell River area. It serves both short-stay road-trippers and longer-term guests, with an RV component that suggests basic outdoor infrastructure on site.
